title: Construction and filtered abutment comparison for termwise hypercohomology pullback
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $K^\bullet$ and $L^\bullet$ be bounded-below complexes of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] on $X$ and $Y$, and let $u:f^{-1}K^\bullet\to L^\bullet$ be a morphism of complexes [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. For the hypercohomology spectral sequences [thm-sp-if-e1] of the global-sections functors on $X$ and $Y$, indexed as $E_1^{p,q}(X,K)=H^p(X_{\Et},K^q)$ and $E_1^{p,q}(Y,L)=H^p(Y_{\Et},L^q)$ with $q$ the filtration degree, the pair $(f,u)$ induces a morphism of spectral sequences [def-sp-spectral-sequence]. Its $E_1^{p,q}$ map is $H^p(X_{\Et},K^q)\xrightarrow{f^*}H^p(Y_{\Et},f^{-1}K^q)\xrightarrow{H^p(u^q)}H^p(Y_{\Et},L^q)$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Its abutment map is the canonical map $H^n(X_{\Et},K^\bullet)\to H^n(Y_{\Et},L^\bullet)$ on derived global sections [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], and it preserves the finite decreasing filtrations by $q$ and commutes with the identifications $E_\infty^{p,q}\cong\operatorname{gr}^qH^{p+q}$ of [thm-sp-if-e1]. The presentations, spectral-sequence maps, stabilization bounds $R(X,K,q,n)$ and isomorphisms $E_r^{q,n-q}\cong\operatorname{gr}^q H^n(X,K)$ for $r\geq\max(1,R(X,K,q,n))$ can be chosen simultaneously for all bounded-below complexes. The canonical abutment map is $P_{f,u}^n=H^n(R\Gamma_X(\eta_f)\,;\,\lambda_f\,;\,R\Gamma_Y(u))$, where $\eta_f$ is the unit of $f^{-1}\dashv Rf_*$ and $\lambda_f:R\Gamma_X Rf_*\cong R\Gamma_Y$ is the Leray comparison. No identity or composition law is asserted.

proof.text: Apply lem-weil-pbc-filtered-resolution-pullback to obtain simultaneously chosen presentations D, spectral-sequence maps M, bounds R and stable-page identifications eInf, with the required E1 formula and concrete filtered comparison.

Exact inverse image carries ρ_X.map to a quasi-isomorphism. Bijectivity of precomposition on homotopy classes into the K-injective resolution ρ_Y constructs a lift j of v; surjectivity of the homotopy quotient on maps gives a chain representative and its homotopy hj. Prove naturality of globalSectionsUpperStarMap by the underived adjunction unit and the terminal-section comparison. Compose its degreewise components with Γ(j); the chain-map equation follows from j.comm and this naturality. Apply the filtered-construction statement to j and w.

Apply lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-pullback-abutment to j and the constructed w. Rewrite the resulting equality against hP to obtain the required ht for the supplied P. Cancel the monic target filtration inclusion and rewrite ht at q and q+1 to prove hc. Apply stable-page compatibility to this hc and retain D,M,R,eInf and the E1 formula unchanged.
